content: pytest-asyncio latest stable version 1.4.0 (2026-05). Supports Python >=3.9. Key for MCP testing: the fdars mcp server already uses synchronous handlers (def not async def) because fdars Rust calls release the GIL via PyReadonly wrappers — no asyncio needed. For auto-tuning loop testing, the loop itself runs synchronously. pytest-asyncio would only be needed if testing against the async MCP Client transport, which is test infrastructure (not the feature code). Currently already in pyproject.toml dev extra via pytest-asyncio. No version bump needed if kept in dev.
